verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's homepage advertises a "Switch from another tool" path, and the Marketing API can create contacts in an audience, so some migration route exists. Nothing shows a guided import flow or that tags, custom fields, or unsubscribe status carry over. One community report describes an account ban after importing 80 sign-ups, which points to compliance friction on imports. missing for 10: documented guided list-import wizard, preservation of tags, preservation of custom fields/merge fields, preservation of unsubscribe/suppression state, hands-on corroboration of a successful migration.
